news.text: #Juve Surging Ahead: #Sørloth With #BaldeNegotiations continue with #AtléticoMadrid and #Barcelona for the two loans. [Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#SPALLETTI: NOW THE REAL #JUVE#Nico and #Conceição are back, #Yildiz is eager to get going: the manager anticipates a turning point.Sunday against #Venezia to start the climb back up: the league is the absolute priority, Champions League qualification is more fundamental than the Europa League. Kenan, on the road to recovery, fires up the fans at the ATP Finals. #Balogun calls #Carnevali, #United calls #McKennie.[Front Page TuttoSport]

🚑 Statement from the Turkish Federation regarding Zeki #Çelik, of #Juventus: "Left hamstring strain".He suffered the muscular issue just a few minutes before the start of France-Turkiye.[@TUTTOJUVE_COM via @PuebloJ]

🚨 #Juventus, new #Çelik alarm!🇹🇷 From Turkiye: discomfort in his left hamstring during the warm-up against France.⚠️ It is the same area as his recent injury. Precautionarily ruled out of the match.[IlBianconero]

🎙 Alessio #Tacchinardi, ex #Juventus midfielder, at an evening hosted by #Juventus Club Capanelle, interviewed by Claudio Zuliani, regarding Alex #DelPiero and a potential return of Antonio #Conte, with whom he recently went on vacation in Egypt:#DELPIERO"I don't like seeing him on Sky, even though he's a very intelligent guy, I love Alex, he's a friend, but I would love to see him at #Juve.I believe these players desperately need 'juventinità', mentality and someone who has been on that pitch and knows what it takes to win.Alex can be the perfect piece to crown his fantastic career and love story with #Juve, so I'm rooting for Alex."#CONTE"I watched all the matches with him, and I tried flo

🚑 Bad news for #Juventus and #Sassuolo: Vasilije #Adzic suffered a physical issue during the match between Cyprus and Montenegro.The Montenegrin had to leave the pitch in the final minutes of the first half, and Milan #Vukotic came on in his place.Both clubs are awaiting updates to learn the type of injury and the potential recovery timeline.[@TUTTOJUVE_COM via @PuebloJ]

🇺🇸🤨 #McKennie, #Pochettino wants him at #ManchesterUnited. For #Juventus, it is not a simple deal: for #Spalletti, he is a cornerstone and the club holds a very strong contractual position. Selling him is not a priority, but due to budget needs and the necessity to trim the squad, a mega-offer could open up an unexpected scenario and a surprise sacrifice, even as early as January.[Giovanni Albanese - Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🇨🇴💪 #Spalletti, who had strongly wanted him, expects greater personality and quality in building from the back from #Lucumí - characteristics he has not yet managed to show consistently. #Juventus hopes to rediscover the version admired at #Bologna, capable of combining defensive aggression and technical quality. The manager is waiting for him, with the goal of making him a fundamental piece in build-up play as well.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

🔛⁉️ The name at the top of the list to solve the number 9 issue is #Sørloth: the intention is to seek an agreement with #AtléticoMadrid, which in recent months had also shown openness to the bianconeri. #David's good performances could lend a hand, perhaps simply to reciprocate the loan until the end of the season. The main alternatives are #Balogun and #Retegui (more difficult).[Giovanni Albanese - Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

👋‼️ #Juventus must work on outgoing transfers in January:🧱 For a good offer, #Gatti could leave, #Cabal is at risk depending on the search for a left-back, while #Rugani will only be able to leave on loan.🎯 #Spalletti would like to have a midfielder, but #McKennie, #Koopmeiners, #DouglasLuiz, #Sarr, #Locatelli and #Thuram are already there. Someone is surplus to requirements and space needs to be made. The idea for this area is not at all clear.⚽️ In attack, the extra player would be #Ekhator: there are 7/8 players for two spots and, considering that the Mister wants a physical center-forward, he and #Zhegrova could say goodbye.[Andrea Losapio - TuttoJuve via @juventusinsidernews]
